notes: Both underdetermined units (v002, v003) carry r00-base and the English realizes every token, so no added or surplus material arises.

Giving *out* to the verb's preverb and a bare *of* to διά remains conceivable, but rule 36 forbids leaving an expressed preposition a bare *of* while the verb takes the particle; the whole prepositional expression is διά's, headed on *out*.
ὁ before ἄνθρωπος is unrepresented because the ASV writes a bare *Man* (rule 23), while the opening ὁ is substantival and supplies *he* (rules 22, 32).
ἐκπορευομένῳ is anarthrous, so the relativizer *that* is the participle's own helper (rule 31).
